data.body: Cluster investigation: same Track A root cause as aa4f-13b3. test-merge-to-main-version-bump.sh (the sibling of test-merge-to-main.sh which received cb4a9a7335's RANDOM-suffix fix) never received the same fix. test_state_write_phase_* PARSE_ERROR is the mid-write torn read fingerprint of the non-atomic in-place writer at version-bump.sh:386 combined with state-file pollution from T1/T2/T3/T5/T6 not cleaning between tests. See aa4f-13b3 comment for full details. Confidence: high.
